tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Search the current promotions at Belgian retailers by product, brand or store, with optional filters. Returns the best matches (biggest per-item discount first unless sorted otherwise), each with price, discount, validity and a link to open it.

tools.name: get_deal
tools.description: One promotion in full, by the id a search result gave.

tools.name: get_buying_guide
tools.description: A researched buying guide (koopwijzer) for a kind of product, e.g. 'airfryer': the models compared (key specs, today's lowest promotion), what each feature does, when you need it and when not, and general facts, every statement with its source. Use it for 'best <product>' and 'which <product> should

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: One model from a buying guide in full: the maker's specs, what tests and buyers say (score, summary, pros, cons, source), facts, and today's promotions for it with their links.

tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: The stores in the data: slug, name, number of current promotions, the median discount per item where known, when the store was last fetched, and the pages of the store and its weekly overview. Also lists the category slugs.

tools.name: publish_card
tools.description: One promotion ready to publish elsewhere: the card as a picture (PNG, the same card the site's share button makes: store, photo, title, what you pay, regular price, label, end date; square by default, or 4:5 feed, 9:16 story, 1200x630 link preview; four designs: a shelf tag, b till receipt, d large

tools.name: get_meal_ideas
tools.description: Meal ideas from the promotions (kookinspiratie): the dishes whose main ingredients are all in promotion at the given Belgian food store(s) on the day the user shops, with those promotions (price, deal, until when, link), the side ingredients that are in promotion too, and what else is needed that is

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Belgian consumer news for people who want to save (dealio.be/nieuws/): prices, promotions, store openings and incidents, product recalls (FAVV), tests (Test-Aankoop), taxes and energy, summarised by dealio in two or three sentences with our own headline, the source and the link to its article, newes
